author: L. Frank (Lyman Frank) Baum
longDescription: Frank Baum is a novel published in 1907. When Dorothy is swept overboard during a sea voyage, she washes ashore in the mysterious Land of Ev with a talking hen named Billina.

authorInfo.bio:
L. Frank (Lyman Frank) Baum (1856–1919) is the author of Ozma of Oz
A Record of Her Adventures with Dorothy Gale of Kansas, the Yellow Hen, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Tiktok, the Cowardly Lion, and the Hungry Tiger; Besides Other Good People too Numerous to Mention Faithfully Recorded Herein. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
